blocks.text: KITAOTAO, Bukidnon – A 70-year-old woman was wounded after she was allegedly hacked with a scythe by an intoxicated neighbor in Kitaotao, Bukidnon, on Sunday. Police identified the elderly victim as a resident of Purok 5, Barangay East Dalurong, Kitaotao, who sustained a wound on her right wrist after being attacked outside a store around 6:15 p.m. Major Jose Regner Sevilleno, chief of the Kitaotao Municipal Police Station, said the victim was standing in front of the store when a 56-year-old male neighbor—believed to be drunk—suddenly approached and hacked her once with a 15-inch scythe without apparent provocation.
